bindLauncherSecrets does Get → annotate → Update with the read resourceVersion and returns any error, which relaunch.go:130-131 turns into a failed launch (the new pod left running, unbound, until the supervisor's next attempt replaces it). This PR adds a second writer of the same Secret, the per-minute refresher (ghcredential.go:100-123), which retries its own 409 once on a fresh read; give the bind the same one-shot re-read-and-retry so a lease turnover landing in the bind's window never fails a launch.

securityLine: Security: authz — the only merge and GitHub-issue-write refusals in the tree are deleted (cmd/legion/gh.go at ef352f15, the pi-legion tool_call hook), on Sami's ruling; every role's gh now acts as its App (podkind.go:191,203; tmux/spawn.go:386-395), so an unauthorized merge is refused only by the repository's branch protection, which Legion never reads (AGENTS.md:174-176), and api/ready.go:54-57 names projects whose base requires nothing; the controller's new set_status is gated by its registration secret (tools.ts:201-212) and the daemon's CONTROLLER_REQUIRED. secret — widened from a 60 s grant handle to the raw one-hour installation token at rest for the pod's life: written into the role Secret (relaunch.go:382-400), projected 0440 read-only into that role's container alone (manifest.go:459-468, fsGroup podUser), rewritten in place by the per-minute refresher (ghcredential.go:97-125); readable by every process of that one container, never another role's, never the controller's (podkind.go:379); on tmux <state_dir>/secrets/<claim>-gh at 0700/0600 (tmux/ghcredential.go:30-36), uid-shared across panes as the grant files were. untrusted-input — the issue key is the only outside text reaching an argv or a path: validated against DISPATCH_KEY_PATTERN then JSON-quoted into the revset (handoff-commit.ts:92-99, 139-150); ready.go builds .legion/<issue> from the daemon's own record. sandbox — one new read-only Secret volume and mount per role container, DefaultMode 0440 (manifest.go:459-468), GHConfigDir and gh-<role> reserved against an operator's mounts (manifest.go:98-114); no capability, policy or namespace sharing changed. agent-def — AGENTS.md, the role prompts and the legion-* skills are edited; every edit describes the mechanism change (plain gh, plain jj git push, threads by node id, the controller's tool ops) and none adds an instruction a reviewer would obey. Hardening (ranked): bindLauncherSecrets' Update vs the refresher's (inline Minor); `legion start --check-config` refusing a provider key named GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_HOST/GH_CONFIG_DIR, which every pane now sets and the shim refuses as a duplicate.
